purpose: Experimental pretrip standard-metered NYC yellow-taxi base fare_amount USD; not a final bill, quote guarantee, or evaluated current model.

feature_derivation.hour: Integer NYC local hour 0..23; sin/cos with period 24, no UTC hour or fractional-minute conversion.
feature_derivation.weekend: Saturday or Sunday in NYC local time.
feature_derivation.holiday: Membership in the checksum-pinned nationwide observed OPM calendar.
feature_derivation.zones: String categories from integer named TLC LocationID domain 1..263, not ordered geographic magnitudes.
feature_derivation.unknown_category: A valid zone unseen during train remains its string value; future fitted categorical preprocessing must use a train-only unknown bucket. Invalid/unknown TLC IDs 264/265 are rejected.

calendar.missing_coverage: reject; never implicitly set future unknown dates to non-holiday

time_policy.now: Freeze an aware UTC submit instant, convert to America/New_York once at submit, store UUID/offset/fold/calendar/tzdb identity; rerun reuses the snapshot.
time_policy.serving: Offset-aware local ISO timestamp plus America/New_York; offset must agree with the zone, ambiguous local time requires fold 0/1, nonexistent local time is rejected.
time_policy.historical: TLC NTZ stays NYC local wall time without inventing an instant or DST fold; repeated fall hour preserves wall features; nonexistent spring hour is rejected.
time_policy.tzdb_artifact_requirement: A fitted artifact must pin the actual America/New_York TZif SHA256 reported by timezone_identity(), plus provider/package version where available. Serving must fail on a mismatch; no fitted v2 artifact exists yet.

request_policy: Exact required snapshot fields; missing fields and unknown extras fail, including route distance in this zone-time-only experiment. A caller cannot omit submit time, clock mode, DST fold or pinned identity to bypass guards.
v1_policy: No change to frozen v1 helpers, 2025 domain, model identity or current production /predict contract. This v2 builder is not connected to dashboard or serving.

pilot.boundaries: Half-open by actual pickup NYC local datetime, not source month.
pilot.holdout_policy: Preparation/counts/overlap only; do not fit preprocessing or tune on holdout, and do not evaluate until the candidate/cohort/features/gates are locked.
